about.subtitle: The story behind my journey in web development.
about.part1: I’m a self-taught web developer proficient in the <mern>MERN stack</mern>. I learned programming through online tutorials and courses, reading documentation, and working on real projects. Over time, I’ve built a number of full-stack projects using the MERN stack - JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB - both personal and freelance. I have a strong foundation in web development and I enjoy understanding not just how things work, but why they work the way that they do. In addition to personal projects, I’ve also developed and deployed freelance real-world applications that are <usability>easy to use</usability> focusing on <reliability>reliability</reliability>, <scalability>scalability</scalability> and <ux>user experience</ux>.
about.part2: I am pursuing programming as a career because I enjoy creating <thoughtful>thoughtful and usefull</thoughtful> tools that can help make life <easier>easier</easier> and less frustrating. Right now, my <goal>goal</goal> is to keep improving my skills in Full-Stack development with a focus on <AI>AI integration</AI> and <Cloud>Cloud technologies</Cloud> technologies by building complex projects and continuously challenging myself.
